Battle_CheckCriticalHit.name: Battle_CheckCriticalHit
Battle_CheckCriticalHit.scenario: seed 7, turn 1 (Charmander Flamethrower vs Machop); port: queue Battle_Random#0 = 20/28/31/34/35/36/81; ares: case 'rule Battle_Random@Battle_CheckCriticalHit 34' and '... 35'
Battle_CheckCriticalHit.observed: Forced roll < 35 gives a critical hit (pre-random damage 190, 'Critical hit!', Machop left at 0 HP shown as 142 damage), >= 35 none (damage 100 -> 90). Threshold 35 = ((base + 76) >> 2) * 2 >> 1 (Stadium rules, D_8438AC60[0] == 1) with base 65 = Charmander's base SPEED; base Defense 43 would give 29 (31 and 34 would not crit). Focus Energy's flag (unk_4D & 4, set by Battle_Effect_FocusEnergy) is read here.
Battle_CheckCriticalHit.ares: same: roll 34 crit (damage 142), 35 no crit (90); ares's caller-tagged trace shows Battle_Random call 0 coming from Battle_CheckCriticalHit; all 3 events identical
Battle_CheckCriticalHit.notes: Name confirmed. Separate naming bug found: it reads gBaseStats[id].baseDefense, which (gBaseStats = gSpeciesData - 0x1C, PokemonStats in gb_data.h) is SpeciesData.baseSpeed. The PokemonStats stat field names are in reverse order (baseSpecial/baseSpeed/baseDefense/baseAttack at 0x07..0x0A read Attack/Defense/Speed/Special). The STAT_* ids used with these fields (gb_data.c) may carry the same reversal: worth its own record.

Battle_ApplyDamageRandomFactor.ares: same calls (callers named Battle_ApplyDamageRandomFactor), same values and damage

Battle_Random.name: Battle_Random
Battle_Random.observed: u8 battle random number; 8 runtime callers: damage factor (457), crit (77), secondary-effect chance (20), Battle_CheckMonCanAct (6), MultiHit, Flinch, Thrash, LowerStat. Forcing a value changes exactly the decision of its caller (crit, burn).
Battle_Random.ares: same call order and callers over 492 logic entries in seed 1
Battle_Random.notes: PORT: the xcheck hook can replace the value; the N64 one steps a generator by osGetCount.

func_843708CC.name: func_843708CC
func_843708CC.scenario: (a) seed 7, accuracy forced 254, and 255 then 0; (b) port-only: Charmander's moves set to Confuse Ray, Hypnosis, Recover, Hypnosis (PORT_EVID_MOVES)
func_843708CC.observed: The hit check. A roll >= moveCache.unk_04 (accuracy after stages) makes the move miss via func_843708A0. 255 is redrawn, so 100%-accuracy moves (unk_04 = 255) never miss: forced 254 still hit (damage 90). Real misses: Machop's Fire Blast (gBattleDamage 16 -> 0 inside this call), Charmander's first Hypnosis (no status). Reached from func_84372670 for damaging moves and from the status-move handlers (Battle_Effect_Sleep, _Confuse, _LeechSeed, _Paralyze, _Counter ...) for status moves: one function, two kinds of paths. Also fails moves on a target in Fly/Dig (unk_4D & 0x10) and Dream Eater (effect 8) on a non-sleeping target.
func_843708CC.ares: forced 254 / 255,0: identical events (no miss), same redraw
func_843708CC.notes: Proposed name: Battle_CheckMoveHit (or Battle_RollAccuracy). The removed 1/256 miss is a Stadium rule change worth a comment.

func_843708A0.name: func_843708A0
func_843708A0.scenario: as func_843708CC (Fire Blast miss, Hypnosis miss)
func_843708A0.observed: gBattleDamage = 0, sBattleMoveFailed = 1, clears user unk_4C bit 0x20. Only caller func_843708CC (11 runtime calls).
func_843708A0.ares: not isolated (no miss forced in ares with a < 100% move)
func_843708A0.notes: Proposed name: Battle_SetMoveMissed. Port-only evidence for the miss itself.

func_84372670.name: func_84372670
func_84372670.observed: Executes one Pokemon's move: only caller Battle_ResolveMonAction (126); runtime callees in order: Battle_CheckMonCanAct, Battle_DecrementPP, Battle_QueueMoveCategoryUsedMessage, Battle_Effect_Counter, Battle_CalcDamage, Battle_CheckCriticalHit, Battle_ApplyTypeEffectAndSTAB, Battle_ApplyDamageRandomFactor, func_843708CC, Battle_ExecuteMoveEffect, Battle_ApplyRageContinuation.
func_84372670.ares: the per-event battle state after each call of its parent matches (seeds 1 and 7)

Battle_Effect_Counter.name: Battle_Effect_Counter
Battle_Effect_Counter.observed: Called for every move (83 times from func_84372670, every species/move), not through gMoveEffectHandlers. Returns 1 at once unless the used move is Counter (0x44); for Counter it doubles the last damage when the target's move was Normal/Fighting.
Battle_Effect_Counter.notes: Not an effect handler: the gate that handles Counter before damage. Proposed: Battle_TryCounter / Battle_HandleCounterMove (returns 'continue normally'). No run used Counter itself: its doubling branch is not reached.

Battle_RunMoveEffect.name: Battle_RunMoveEffect
Battle_RunMoveEffect.scenario: all runs, plus the two move-injection runs
Battle_RunMoveEffect.observed: Dispatches gMoveEffectHandlers[effect - 1]: 18 different handlers seen at runtime (SecondaryStatusChance, LeechSeed, Poison, Paralyze, MultiHit, Flinch, LowerStat, RaiseOwnStat, Recoil, Thrash, TwoTurnMove, ReflectLightScreen, Confuse, Sleep, Heal, Haze, FocusEnergy, Substitute). The watched state change of each call is the handler's (e.g. Recover HP 60 -> 123).
Battle_RunMoveEffect.notes: Battle_RunMoveEffect is inlined into Battle_ExecuteMoveEffect: call-site addresses name the wrapper, the shadow stack names the real parent.

Battle_ExecuteMoveEffect.name: Battle_ExecuteMoveEffect
Battle_ExecuteMoveEffect.observed: Wrapper of Battle_RunMoveEffect. Runtime caller only func_84372670 (78); the static callers Battle_ApplyDamage and func_8436FDBC never called it in these battles.

Battle_Effect_SecondaryStatusChance.name: Battle_Effect_SecondaryStatusChance

Battle_Effect_SecondaryStatusChance.observed: Flamethrower's 10% burn: roll 0 (< 0x1A) burns Machop: status 0 -> 0x10, Attack 98 -> 49 (through func_84370B44), message 'It was burned!'. The natural roll 48 does nothing.
Battle_Effect_SecondaryStatusChance.ares: identical events 0-9 (burn, halved Attack, burn damage); the first difference is the next Flamethrower, which the ares rule burns as well and the port queue does not

func_84370B44.name: func_84370B44
func_84370B44.observed: Halves Attack (BattleMonRuntime.unk_2A, min 1) when status & 0x10 (burn): 98 -> 49 when called from Battle_Effect_SecondaryStatusChance. Runtime callers: func_84370B7C (31, stat recompute at switch-in) and Battle_Effect_RaiseOwnStat (6); static also LowerStat, SecondaryStatusChance, Battle_ApplyRageStatBoost.
func_84370B44.ares: the halved Attack (0x31) is in the matching event 2
func_84370B44.notes: Proposed: Battle_ApplyBurnAttackPenalty. Its twin func_84370B0C quarters Speed (unk_2E) on paralysis (status & 0x40); reached from Battle_Effect_Paralyze but not watched.

Battle_ApplyResidualEffects.name: Battle_ApplyResidualEffects

Battle_ApplyResidualEffects.notes: BattleMonRuntime.unk_0E / unk_10: pending HP for the HP-bar transition (naming candidates).

func_84370ADC.name: func_84370ADC
func_84370ADC.observed: Called from 9 places at runtime (BattleScene_ActionSetupFinalizeStep 8159, Battle_ResolveMonAction 252, BattleScene_RunActionEffectHpTransition 76, phases 7/17 ...). By the code it copies the active Pokemon's status to its party entry (BattleMon.unk_05); that party memory is not in the captured state.
